tournament.name: October OCC Clash Qualifier A
tournament.description:
OCC CLASH OCTOBER SCHEDULE: Qualifier Brackets - October 14 @ 1300 GMT (deck list deadline October 14 @ 1200 GMT) - (participation confirmation deadline October 13th)

  • The qualifier brackets are seeded based on the position of the player on the OC leader-board at the end of the season.

Round of 8 Finals - October 28 @ 1300 GMT (deck list deadline October 26 @ 2300 GMT) -The Round of 8 Finals are seeded based on OC leaderboard at the end of the season in addition to the final 2 qualified players being positioned in #7 and #8.
